description: Surface the consequential structural decisions a change embeds, each framed as a judgment question for a human with taste (`fallow decision-surface --format json`). The apex of the review brief and the single call that puts taste-decisions in front of a reviewer; separable and cheap, it runs the same changed-code analysis as the brief, not the full project pipeline. Returns `kind: "decision-surface"` with `schema_version`, a ranked `decisions[]` list, an optional `truncated` note, and `signal_count`. Each decision carries a `signal_id` (a deterministic anchor to the fallow-emitted candidate it frames; an agent decision whose `signal_id` fallow did not emit must be rejected, so a decision cannot name a signal that fallow did not find), a `category` (exactly one of `coupling-boundary`, `public-api-contract` and `dependency`), the framed `question`, the `anchor_file`/`anchor_line`, the `blast` (modules affected beyond the diff) and `consequence` rank, the routed `expert[]` (who to ask) with a `bus_factor_one` flag, and structured `actions[]` (`ask-expert`, `suppress`). The surface is capped to a small number of decisions (default 4, configurable via `max_decisions`, clamped to 3-5); decisions beyond the cap collapse into `truncated`. Every `coupling-boundary` and `public-api-contract` decision is suppressible with a `// fallow-ignore` comment on the anchor file (the `suppress` action carries the paste-ready comment); a `dependency` decision anchors on a `package.json`, which cannot carry a comment, so it has no `suppress` action. Always exits 0 (advisory, never a gate). Use `base` to pick the comparison point (defaults to the git merge-base). Use this to answer "what are the few decisions in this change that actually need human judgment?" rather than scanning the whole diff.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

base.description:
Git ref to compare against (e.g., "main", "HEAD~5"). When unset, the
base is the git merge-base against the branch's upstream or the remote
default (`origin/main`); set `FALLOW_AUDIT_BASE` in the server env to pin
it.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

max_decisions.description:
Cap on the number of consequential structural decisions surfaced (the
working-memory limit). Default 4; clamped to the 3-5 band (4 plus or minus
1).

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: decision_surface
